d:
Official 2016 Vidya Vox cover of A.R. Rahman's "Taal Se Taal Mila," feat. Alka Yagnik & Udit Narayanan.
Hey guys! Here is my take/remix of "Taal Se Taal Mila", which is one of my all time favorite A.R. Rahman songs! We shot some of this at the Jodhpur Palace in Rajasthan, India, which is one of the most stunning places I have ever been to. Also, shoutout to the amazing Rajasthani dancer who was kind enough to join in the fun during the shoot. She's so awesome!
If you're curious about the outfits I wore - I designed them myself!
